newsitem.title: USA: Dow changes course, gains more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow changes course, gains more than 50 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average abruptly changed direction and gained more than 50 points in late afternoon trading on Monday, as bargain hunters re-emerged following Friday's near-record plunge.

At 3:22 p.m. EDT, the 30-share Dow was up 51.56 points at 7,746.22, which reactivated the New York Stock Exchange's limits on program trading. Earlier, the Dow was off more than 50 points in a continuation of its pre-weekend sell-off of 247 points.
